LanguageData.Grechka_UpgradeArmorT4.label: upgrade: archo armor (T4)
LanguageData.Grechka_UpgradeArmorT4.description: The previous item and its electronics are credited in full. Add only plasteel and the new tier material. One item becomes one upgraded item; production bonuses do not duplicate upgrades. Quality is determined by the crafter.
